# Stylo derive compatibility

Source: crates.io `stylo_derive` 0.22.0, from the Servo project
(<https://github.com/servo/stylo>), MPL-2.0. The original package metadata and
source headers are retained.

Runyte's desktop executable combines Stylo with GPUI's structured logging.
The latter enables `serde_fmt`, which supplies another conversion into
`std::fmt::Error`. The untyped `Ok(())` generated by `ToCss` is then ambiguous
when followed by `?` (E0282/E0283).

The only source change is in `to_css.rs`: generated successful results explicitly
name `std::fmt::Error`. This preserves the formatting API and generated behavior,
without removing a conversion from another dependency or changing the engine.
The combined desktop build and preview acceptance exercise the affected derives.
Remove this patch when an upstream version supplies equivalent type annotations.
